language.name: English
nav.addressWith: Search with {engine} or type an address
nav.pinTitle: Pin this page as a new tab of the list
browse.empty: Search or type an address in the bar above. You can set a start page in the Settings.
home.addPlaceholder: Address of the site to add (e.g. https://example.com)
home.bookmarksDesc: Import the browsers' bookmarks into the lists, or export the lists to a bookmark file to open in a browser.
lists.emptyNew: No sites. Add one below: the list will be created.
lists.confirmRemove: Remove the list "{name}" and all its sites?
preset.found: There is a predefined list for {name} ({count}).
site.confirmRemove: Remove "{name}" from the list of sites?
addDialog.message: Address of the site to add:
openDialog.message: This page wants to open {url} in a new tab, but the list has no tab for that site. Add it to the list?
importDialog.message: Choose the bookmarks to add to a list, from a browser or from a file exported by a browser.
bookmarks.fileOnly: To import a browser's bookmarks, export them from the browser to an HTML file (from its bookmark manager), then import that file with “File…”.
bookmarks.deniedSource: The system does not allow reading these bookmarks.
bookmarks.denied: The system does not allow reading the bookmarks of: {browsers}. Or export them from the browser to an HTML file and import it with “File…”.
exportDialog.message: Choose the sites to save to a bookmark file, which browsers can import. Each list becomes a folder.
settings.title: Settings
settings.hideOnBlur: Hide the overlay when it loses focus
settings.hideOnBlurDesc: For example when clicking on the game or on another window.
settings.browseStartDesc: The page the Browse tab opens at first. Empty: no page, you type an address.
settings.searchCustomDesc: Search address, with %s in place of the searched text.
settings.opacityDesc: Lower values let you see what is behind the window, for example the game.
settings.unloadAfterDesc: The pages you are not looking at (the other tabs, the pages of the other lists, all of them while the overlay is hidden) stay open for this long, then they are closed to free memory. Opening the tab again reloads the last address visited. A list always opens again on the last tab used (the Home or Settings too).
memory.kind.private: Private memory of each process of the app. Every open page uses memory until it is closed, those of the other lists too.
memory.kind.pss: Memory of each process of the app, with shared memory split among the processes (PSS). Every open page uses memory until it is closed, those of the other lists too.
memory.kind.footprint: Memory of each process of the app, as shown by Activity Monitor. Every open page uses memory until it is closed, those of the other lists too.
memory.kind.workingSet: Physical memory of each process of the app: shared memory is counted more than once, so the total is an overestimate. Every open page uses memory until it is closed, those of the other lists too.
shortcut.press: Press the new combination (Esc to cancel).
shortcut.needModifier: Use a function key (F1–F24) or a combination with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.
shortcut.error: Cannot use {accelerator}: invalid combination or already in use.
